business_summary: Jilin Sino-Microelectronics Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, development, manufacture, sale, packaging, testing, and marketing of discrete semiconductor devices in China and internationally. The company offers metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistors (MOSFETs), insulated-gate bipolar transistors (IGBTs), IGBT power modules / PIMs and PMs, Schottky barrier diodes (SBDs), fast recovery diodes (FRDs), silicon-controlled rectifiers (SCRs), bipolar junction transistors (BJTs), intelligent power modules (IPMs), and high-voltage rectifier diodes (HVRDs). It also provides wide-bandgap semiconductors, integrated circuits, power electronic products, automotive electronic products, self-contained semiconductors, automation instruments, electronic components, and application software. In addition, the company is involved in the sale of tools, molds, and communication electronic equipment. Its products are used in the clean energy, automotive electronics, rail transportation, intelligent manufacturing, smart homes, smart devices, and low-altitude economy industries. The company exports its products. Jilin Sino-Microelectronics Co., Ltd. was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Jilin, China.

(HVRD). 또한 광대역 갭 반도체, 집적 회로, 전력 전자 제품, 자동차 전자 제품, 독립형 반도체, 자동화 장비, 전자 부품 및 응용 소프트웨어를 제공합니다. 그밖에 공구, 금형, 통신전자장비 판매도 하고 있습니다. 해당 제품은 청정 에너지, 자동차 전자 제품, 철도 운송, 지능형 제조, 스마트 홈, 스마트 장치 및 저고도 경제 산업에 사용됩니다. 회사는 제품을 수출합니다. 길림중소전자공학유한회사는 F.
